## Skyrim Milk and Milking Armor Lore

Skyrim milk comes from Milk Maids and is a common staple drink with exotic aphrodisiac properties. Kinky Living, Parasite, and Dwemer milking armor and devices are known to trap unsuspecting adult women. For kinky women who welcome such contraptions, their relentless teasing can provide sublime ecstasy.

## Milk Maid Lore

{actor} is a Milk Maid and produces milk.

cow milk is considered barbaric. Milk Maids are the socially valued backbone of Skyrim's milk supply.
